name: bg-highlight-zoom-portrait
title: Highlight-Zoom Background — multi-hop focus pushes with dwell (portrait 9:16)
description: One-shot background: the camera pushes into a sequence of focus points on a full-bleed photo — eased push, dwelling with a micro-drift, then dipping the zoom back slightly before the next hop (director reframing rhythm, no hard cuts). Focus points are clamped zoom-aware so the viewport never leaves the image. Hops span scene_dur, then the last focus holds still. Landscape 16:9 twin of bg-highlight-zoom-portrait.

variables.label: Image
variables.description: Full-bleed cover image the camera explores (URL or project asset path)

variables.label: Focuses
variables.description: Focus points as normalized "x,y" pairs separated by ";" (1-4 points), visited in order; clamped so the zoomed viewport never leaves the image

variables.label: Dwell
variables.description: Rest seconds at each focus before the next hop (1-8)

variables.label: Drift
variables.description: Micro-drift during dwell in px/s (0-30), keeps the rest alive

variables.label: Base zoom
variables.description: Opening zoom level before the first push (1-1.5)

variables.label: Scrim
variables.description: Black overlay strength for text readability 0-1

variables.label: Scene duration
variables.description: Plan to cut around this length; the hop sequence spans it (5-60), then the last focus holds still
